### Bio

Hello! My name is Elise LaFreniere. Welcome to my website! I am an undergraduate student at the University of California, Santa Barbara (UCSB) studying Environmental Studies. 

My career interests focus on buisness consulting, climate change, conservation, and reseearch around intertidal ecology.
